events.description: Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat: one in a dark suit delivers a high kick toward the other, who is wearing light-colored clothing and appears to be blocking or evading.

A person in a dark suit lies incapacitated on a metal platform while another individual repeatedly steps on a silver briefcase placed near the victim’s head/upper body, indicating deliberate targeting of a helpless person.

Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight on a multi-level car parking structure. One man (in dark suit) is initially on the ground, then rises and exchanges blows, kicks, and uses a briefcase as a weapon against the other man (in light suit), who also uses the briefcase offensively. The combat includes grappling, striking, and dynamic movement around parked cars.

Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight in a car showroom; one man (dark suit) is initially struck, then counters by grabbing and throwing the other (light suit), who uses a large rectangular object (possibly a car part or container) as a weapon.

After being thrown, the man in the light suit lies incapacitated on the car lift while the man in the dark suit stands over him; the standing man then delivers a downward strike or stomp, indicating attack on a helpless victim.

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat on a car assembly line; one man in a dark suit strikes and overpowers another man in a light-colored shirt, culminating in the latter being thrown onto a conveyor platform.

After being knocked down, the man in the light shirt lies incapacitated on the conveyor while the man in the suit stands over him and appears to deliver additional strikes or压制 (restraining/pressing down), indicating abuse of a helpless victim.

The man in the light shirt, now on the ground, attempts to rise or resist while the man in the suit continues to engage physically—grabbing, pushing, or striking—indicating renewed mutual or asymmetric combat.
